info.name: Authorization Tokens Accounts fund reports - target date series API
Get a Target Date Series Report

params.name: StrategyId
params.description: A unique identifier for a specific fund. For example, STUSA04D0O

params.name: locale
params.description: Language and locale, for example, en-US

items.docs: Get a Target Date Series Report for the fund specified in the `StrategyId` parameter.</br></br>To override the default value in the Accept-Language HTTP header, use the `locale` parameter.</br></br>In the `pageSize` parameter, you can specify the page size for the returned PDF. Page size options are `Letter`.</br></br>If a report exists, a presigned URL from which you can download the PDF is returned in the response.
